senses.gloss:
Aurva, ‘descendant of uru or Urva,’ appears in the Rigveda in close connexion with bhṛgu, being probably a bhṛgu himself. As in one passage of the aitareya brāhmaṇa, the descendants of aitaśa are called the worst of the Aurvas, while the parallel version of the kauṣītaki brāhmaṇa calls them the worst of the Bhṛgus, the Aurvas must have been a branch of the larger family of the Bhṛgus. aurva himself is said in the taittirīya Saṃhitā to have received offspring from atri. In the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa two Aurvas are referred to as authorities. See also kutsa.
